app.agent_busy: this agent is already working; wait or stop the session
app.client_not_installed: %s is not installed (or not on the PATH)
app.test_prompt: Hello, are you ready? Answer in one line.

git.local_origin: local origin: branch pushed, no PR; the merge will be local
git.no_changes: the agent did not change any file
git.no_remote_or_gh: no origin or no gh: the merge will be local
git.not_approved: %s has not been approved in review yet
git.not_repo: the project folder is not a git repository
git.pr_body:
**%s: %s**

Done when: %s

Summary: %s

🤖 Opened by TeamAgent Orchestrator
git.review_context:
You are on the branch %s. See the changes with: git diff %s...%s
Diff summary:
%s
git.turned_off: turned off in Tools → Git flow
import.agents_busy: agents are working: wait or stop the sessions before importing
models.no_way_out: %s and there is no other model or free reserve
models.switch_hint: %s: switch the model or turn on automatic switching (Tools → Models and quotas)
prompt.changes_requested: The previous review asked for changes; see the history below.
prompt.do_task: Do the task. When you finish, write as the last line a summary of what was done. If you need a decision from the user to go on, stop and end the answer with ONE question (ending in ?).
prompt.generate:
Break the objective below into 3 to 8 small, verifiable tasks, and assign each one to the best agent of the team.
Objective: %s

Team (id: name (role)):
%s

Do not run anything and do not change files: only plan. Answer ONLY with a JSON array, with no text before or after:
[{"title": "short task", "done": "how to know it is finished", "assignee": "<agent id>", "priority": "normal"}]
prompt.identity: You are %s (%s) on the team of the project %s.
prompt.review:
Review the task %s done by another agent: %s
Done when: %s
Summary from whoever did it: %s

Check in the project files whether the done criterion was met. Do not change anything.
Answer with a line that starts with APPROVED or with CHANGES: followed by what needs to change.
tasks.generated_done: %d tasks proposed in the Sprints tab
tasks.generated_unreadable: could not read the generated tasks: %v
tasks.no_reviewer: no reviewer available: it needs an active agent on another client
tasks.reviewer_same_client: the reviewer %s ended up on the same client as whoever did the task (%s)
tasks.same_client_reviewer: %s uses the same client as whoever did the task (%s): picking another reviewer
tasks.still_proposal: %s is still a proposal: approve it first
tasks.unclear_verdict: the reviewer gave no clear verdict: %s
